header: THE SHAPE EVERY LIVE ROUTE ANSWERS IN, and the checks the browser applies before it shows anything: where the numbers came from, when they were fetched, and whether the source failed and these are the last good ones. My rule: a card never shows a number without its source and its time.

symbols.name: SourceLink
doc: One place the numbers came from, with a link to it.

members.name: fetchedAt
doc: ISO time the data was fetched from the source.

members.name: source
doc: The source, in words ("IBJA (India Bullion and Jewellers Association)").

members.name: sourceUrl
doc: A link to the source's own page.

members.name: sources
doc: Used when the figures come from several places, each with its own link (the card then names and links every one). Absent for a card with one source.

members.name: stale
doc: True when the source failed just now, and this is the last good answer.

symbols.name: validEnvelope
symbols.sig: export function validEnvelope(x: unknown): x is LiveEnvelope<unknown>

symbols.name: Persist
doc: A card may keep its last good answer in the database too (`persist`): it is saved whenever a fresh answer is had, and shown, marked stale with its own time, when the source fails AND the memory holds nothing (a restart, a quiet night). `check` says whether a saved answer is the shape the card expects.

symbols.name: liveRoute
symbols.sig: export async function liveRoute<T>(opts: { key: string; ttlMs: number; source: string; sourceUrl: string; sourceLinks?: SourceLink[] | ((data: T) => SourceLink[]); load: () => Promise<T>; persist?: Persist<T> }): Promise<NextResponse>

params.name: opts
params.type: { key: string; ttlMs: number; source: string; sourceUrl: string; sourceLinks?: SourceLink[] | ((data: T) => SourceLink[]); load: () => Promise<T>; persist?: Persist<T> }

doc: The whole of a live route: the answer (fresh, or the last good one) or a plain failure. The host caches it for a short while.
